class.name: TrackRenderingLook
class.brief_description: The assets the core's tracks are drawn with.
class.description: What [StandardTrackRenderingBackend] draws a track with: the materials of its rails, bed, formation and of a road's carriageway and shoulders, and a sleeper of each kind. A track says what it is ([TrackData]); its look is the renderer's.

method.name: bed_get_material
method.description: The material of a bed of [param bed]; [code]null[/code] when the look has none.

method.name: sleeper_get_material
method.description: The material of a sleeper of [param kind]; [code]null[/code] when the look has none.

method.name: sleeper_get_mesh
method.description: The mesh of a sleeper of [param kind]; [code]null[/code] when the look has none.

method.name: surface_get_material
method.description: The material of a carriageway of [param surface]; [code]null[/code] when the look has none.

members.member: [code]{TrackData.SleeperKind: Mesh}[/code], the sleeper's top at 0 and its length across X; a kind with none gets the backend's own.
